content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani is 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Postgraduate degree with an M.Sc. in Physics to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete application with all required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, plus 30% HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online interview via Zoom or Google Meet, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Does BITS Pilani offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for this particular recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow recruitment is ANRF/ECRG/2025/003443/PMS.

faq.question: Q9. Where is BITS Pilani located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus, located in Telangana, with a pincode of 500078.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani.
